args.body:
Summary of Corvid Packaging newsletter, linked article, and companion piece:

- Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, highlighting new data on return rates and cost-saving strategies for retailers.
- The linked article reports that apparel return rates reached 24%, and that consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
- The companion piece adds that reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Corvid Packaging: Retail Returns Logistics — Combined Summary
